value.signature: fn encode_local_declaration (value : & LocalAuthorityDeclaration , limits : & ReadAllowances) -> Result < Vec < u8 > , FragmentError >

review.body: { value . validate () . map_err (| _ | FragmentError :: Field) ? ; encoded (& local_declaration_value (value) , limits) }
review.item_premise: Caller-selected fragment codecs read complete public component bytes under supplied limits and return bounded public refusals. They neither select an evaluator nor establish publication binding.
